# Sample job descriptions (test data only)

Five realistic, **fictional** job descriptions used for technical and functional
testing of JobMatch Analysis (M2). Company names are invented. They are never
shown in the product. Each one deliberately mixes must-have and nice-to-have
wording and includes a few vague requirements, so every analysis section is exercised.

| File | Role | Level |
|---|---|---|
| `01-product-manager.txt` | Product Manager | Mid (3–5 yrs) |
| `02-senior-business-analyst.txt` | Senior Business Analyst | Senior (6+ yrs) |
| `03-ai-product-manager.txt` | AI Product Manager | Senior (5–8 yrs) |
| `04-product-owner.txt` | Product Owner | Entry–mid (2+ yrs) |
| `05-technical-product-manager.txt` | Technical Product Manager | Senior (7+ yrs) |
